messages:
Marisol: Hey @it-team, Eli (new hire) can't complete Okta MFA setup. Okta errors when inserting YubiKey: 'unknown device'. Google Drive also not accessible (403). Can someone check group provisioning? :wave:

Eli Santos: I'm on a MacBook Pro (M1, macOS 12.6). Plugging YubiKey (USB-C) shows green light but Okta still says 'No registered factor'. 1Password invite says 'accepted' but vaults empty.

Toni: Hi @Marisol @Eli — will start with Okta groups. Eli, can you confirm your GSuite email exactly? Also try a different USB-C port or hub bypass.

Eli Santos: Email is eli.santos@redwood.com. Tried hub and direct port, same.

Lisa: @Toni I saw a similar case where the YubiKey serial didn't map to device record during provisioning — needs device reassignment. @it-support-bot can you open a ticket to reassign token?

it-support-bot: Ticket #INC-2026 created: 'YubiKey reassignment for eli.santos'. Assigned to IT-Onboard. ETA 2 business hours.

Sean: @Eli run `ykman info` in terminal and paste output (no sensitive keys, just serial/model). If ykman not installed: `brew install yubikey-personalization`.

Eli Santos: pasted output:
```
$ ykman info
Device type: YubiKey 5 NFC
Serial number: 1234567
Form factor: USB-C
Firmware: 5.2.3
```

Toni: Serial looks fine. @Sean I'll reassign token in Okta. Also checking SCIM group sync for 'new-hires-2026' — recent sync failed for some users.

Sean: SCIM sync error was a transient 429 from GSuite; manual re-sync done. @Toni please re-run provisioning for Eli.

Toni: Done. Re-provisioned. Eli, try to sign in to okta.redwood.com and register MFA again.

Eli Santos: Okta now shows 'Add security key' flow. Inserted YubiKey and success! :tada: Google Drive access restored.

Marisol: Awesome. @it-support-bot please close INC-2026 with resolution notes.

it-support-bot: Ticket #INC-2026 status: Resolved. Closure comment: Reassigned YubiKey in Okta and re-triggered SCIM sync. Documented steps: https://redwood.internal/docs/onboarding/okta-mfa (internal).

Marisol: Thanks everyone — adding Eli to #eng and #product channels. Welcome @Eli :wave:

Eli Santos: Thanks all! Appreciate the quick help. :slightly_smiling_face:
